description: Source code for an Android audio effect visualizer, implementing effect interface, effect creation, configuration, processing, and descriptor functions.

classes.name: VisualizerContext
classes.description: Holds state and configuration data for the visualizer effect.

methods.name: Visualizer_reset
methods.description: Resets the visualizer context buffers and state.

methods.name: Visualizer_setConfig
methods.description: Sets the input/output audio configuration for the visualizer.

methods.name: Visualizer_init
methods.description: Initializes the visualizer with default settings.

methods.name: VisualizerLib_QueryNumberEffects
methods.description: Returns the number of effects available in the library.

methods.name: VisualizerLib_QueryEffect
methods.description: Provides the descriptor for a specific effect index.

methods.name: VisualizerLib_Create
methods.description: Creates a new visualizer effect instance.

methods.name: VisualizerLib_GetDescriptor
methods.description: Retrieves the effect descriptor for a given UUID.

methods.name: Visualizer_process
methods.description: Processes audio buffers for visualization, capturing and scaling audio data.

methods.name: Visualizer_command
methods.description: Handles control commands for the visualizer effect, including configuration, capture, and state changes.
